title: The Miniature Microcars of Amsterdam
summary: Not Just Bikes looks at the tiny microcars such as the Canta seen around Amsterdam. It discusses how they serve people with mobility issues, can use bike paths under certain rules, and where they fit in a 21st century city.
why: Linked in self-driving and car-dependence threads as an example of small vehicles that help disabled and elderly people without full-size cars.
